definitions.gloss: offertory box; donation box at a shrine or temple
definitions.explanation: Found at the front of Japanese shrines and temples for monetary offerings.

examples.japanese: {賽銭|さいせん}{箱|ばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put money into the offertory box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{賽銭|さいせん}{箱|ばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{五円|ごえん}{玉|だま}→五円玉：29055_goendama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げ{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I tossed a five-yen coin into the shrine's offertory box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賽銭|さいせん}{箱|ばこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: During New Year's, long lines form in front of the offertory box.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{賽銭|さいせん}→賽銭：05958_saisen⟧ (monetary offering) + {箱|ばこ} (box). The large wooden box placed in front of the main hall at Japanese shrines and temples where visitors toss coins as part of their prayer or wish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賽銭|さいせん}{箱|ばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put money in the offertory box
- {賽銭|さいせん}{箱|ばこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to put hands together in front of the offertory box
- {賽銭|さいせん}{箱|ばこ}⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧: offertory box thief

CULTURAL NOTE:
The standard worship procedure at a Shinto shrine is to toss a coin into the {賽銭|さいせん}{箱|ばこ}, ring the bell, bow twice, clap twice, pray, and bow once more. Five-yen coins (⟦{五円|ごえん}{玉|だま}→五円玉：29055_goendama⟧) are popular because {五円|ごえん} sounds like {御縁|ごえん} (divine connection). At Buddhist temples, the procedure differs slightly, with no clapping.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賽銭|さいせん}→賽銭：05958_saisen⟧: the offering itself (the money)
- ⟦{奉納|ほうのう}→奉納：12200_hounou⟧{箱|ばこ}: votive offering box (for non-monetary offerings)
- ⟦{募金|ぼきん}→募金：11830_bokin⟧{箱|ばこ}: donation box, collection box (secular)
